sentences.text: This I.A. has been filed for impleading the informant in this case as opposite party no.2.
As the case has been registered under Section 363, 366, 376(3) of IPC read with Section 4(2) of the POCSO Act, the prayer for impletion of the informant-opposite party no.2 is allowed.
3. The consolidated cause title has already been filed along with I.A. Registry shall substitute the relevant page in the BLAPL and include in the digital record.
4. Issue notice to the opp. parties.

Notice on behalf of the opp.
party no.1 is accepted by Mr. S.S. Pradhan, learned Addl. Govt. Advocate for the State.
5. Requisites for issuance of notice to the opposite party no.2 through Registered Post with A.D shall be filed within three working days.
The notice shall be made returnable within four weeks.

6. Learned counsel for the appellant shall also serve an extra copy of the brief on Mr. Pradhan,
learned Addl. Government Advocate within three working days, for service of notice on opposite party no.2 through the concerned I.O./I.I.C, who shall also inform the opposite party no.2 about the date of the posting of the case and that he/she can appear in Court through counsel or from the Police Station through Video Conferencing to oppose/ support the prayer for bail.
